story.title: my good health chatter
paragraphs_en: once a girl was eating junk food . Her mother was saying him that "junk food is not good for our body" but she said no " i like to eat junk food and i will eat it only i won't eat healthy food " she said to her mom. yum!
why aren't you eating your food. But I want to eat junk food
So what did you ate today ? I ate junk food today I ate healthy food today
The next she falls sick and her mother said that " you fell sick because you ate so much junk food yesterday " .
The next day when the girl was feeling nice she went to the school and the teacher was teaching about food pyramid.
After that her relatives came to visit her they gave her so much junk food but the girl said no that "I don't want to eat junk food and I will only eat healthy food " she said to his relatives.
now I will eat only healthy food

sentences.text_en: once a girl was eating junk food .
sentences.text_vi: Ngày xưa, có một cô bé đang ăn đồ ăn vặt.

sentences.text_en: Her mother was saying him that "junk food is not good for our body" but she said no " i like to eat junk food and i will eat it only i won't eat healthy food " she said to her mom. yum!
sentences.text_vi: Mẹ cô bé nói rằng "Đồ ăn vặt không tốt cho cơ thể mình đâu", nhưng cô bé không chịu, nói với mẹ: "Con thích ăn đồ ăn vặt và con sẽ chỉ ăn đồ ăn vặt thôi, con sẽ không ăn đồ ăn tốt cho sức khỏe đâu!". Ngon quá!

sentences.text_en: The next she falls sick and her mother said that " you fell sick because you ate so much junk food yesterday " .
sentences.text_vi: Ngày hôm sau, cô bé bị ốm và mẹ cô bé nói rằng: "Con bị ốm là vì hôm qua con đã ăn quá nhiều đồ ăn vặt đấy".

sentences.text_en: The next day when the girl was feeling nice she went to the school and the teacher was teaching about food pyramid.
sentences.text_vi: Ngày hôm sau, khi cô bé cảm thấy khỏe hơn, cô bé đi học và cô giáo đang dạy về tháp dinh dưỡng.

sentences.text_en: After that her relatives came to visit her they gave her so much junk food but the girl said no that "I don't want to eat junk food and I will only eat healthy food " she said to his relatives.
sentences.text_vi: Sau đó, những người họ hàng của cô bé đến thăm. Họ mang cho cô bé rất nhiều đồ ăn vặt, nhưng cô bé từ chối, nói với họ hàng rằng: "Cháu không muốn ăn đồ ăn vặt đâu, cháu sẽ chỉ ăn đồ ăn tốt cho sức khỏe thôi!"

sentences.text_en: now I will eat only healthy food
sentences.text_vi: Bây giờ con sẽ chỉ ăn đồ ăn tốt cho sức khỏe thôi.
